description: This file defines the MacNodeModeCoordinator class responsible for managing the lifecycle and network interactions of the Mac node in the OpenClaw project. It handles starting/stopping tasks, connecting to a gateway, managing capabilities and permissions, and reacting to configuration changes.

classes.name: MacNodeModeCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the node's network connection, configuration, and state for the MacOS version of the OpenClaw application.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the coordinator task if not already running, starting the main run loop.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels the running task and disconnects the session.

methods.name: setPreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Sets the preferred gateway stable ID and disconnects the current session to reconfigure.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main asynchronous loop managing connection retries, configuration changes, and message handling.

methods.name: currentCaps
methods.description: Determines current capabilities of the node based on user settings and configurations.

methods.name: currentPermissions
methods.description: Fetches current permission statuses for the node asynchronously.

methods.name: currentCommands
methods.description: Generates a list of supported commands based on current capabilities.

methods.name: buildSessionBox
methods.description: Builds a WebSocket session wrapper with TLS parameters based on the gateway URL.
